lead: Sunil Gavaskar is an Indian cricketer, born on 10 July 1949 in Mumbai.
As of 2026, he is 77 years old, and his birth date places him under the Cancer sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Mumbai cricket team and has been recognised with Arjuna Award and Wisden Cricketer of the Year.
This profile collects the Sunil facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
